text1: LoRA trains small adapter matrices while freezing the base model.
text2: Low-rank adapters let you fine-tune with much less GPU memory.

text1: QLoRA keeps the base weights quantized during training.
text2: 4-bit base weights plus higher-precision adapters reduce VRAM use.

text1: A dataset audit reports objective readiness per schema.

text1: RabbitMQ carries dataset and fine-tune job messages.
text2: Workers consume queue messages instead of polling the database.

text1: Prompt-only rows are used for PPO and GRPO style training.

text1: Raw text corpora support continued pre-training.
text2: CPT and pretrain both expect clean text documents without chat roles.
